title: Mixed Event — Hear Me! Hopeful Show♪ — Episode6 A Chance Meeting

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! continue their livestreams, but Minori is plagued with unease as she fails to find acceptance from the group's fans. One day, an opportunity arises for a collaboration with a famous former idol turned streamer...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...
Minori, raise your arms more!
And don't forget to smile!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oww... Sorry!
Please, just one more time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Fine, but take a break first.
I'm sure you're getting tired...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay!
I need to do more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Something only I can do, like Miku and the others said...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But what...? I can't figure it out...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I want to stop being such a bother to everyone! I have to keep practicing! I have to catch up! I have to make it in time for our show...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great work, everyone.
We're much more in sync now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have ways to go before it's ready for the stage, but we can keep working on it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...! There are still some parts I need to work on so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One last time...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori, wait! Calm down!
We can do that tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You won't get everything right by just cramming everything into one day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand that you're anxious, but you physically won't be able to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Resting is just as important as practicing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've already come quite a long way after just one day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right. I know you want our show to go well, but we should go home and rest for today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay. Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess I am getting a little too anxious. I'll just keep going through it in my head for now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, I think I should go home soon! See you tomorrow...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: M-Minori...!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know I shouldn't get so anxious but...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If I don't get better in time for our show, I'll just end up disappointing everyone that's watching...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do I do...?

Huh? Are you...?
Minori from MORE MORE JUMP!?

Y-You're Minori, right?!
I can't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Me?! Are you sure?! I mean, yes, I am Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't look anything like Haruka! I'm nothing like the others, and I'm sorry to disappoint you like this but...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line:
I am sure! I'm your fan, Minori!
Would it be okay if we shake hands...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (M-My fan...?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're the first...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But are you really sure about that...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't dance or sing nearly as well as the others and...

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: You cheer me up every time I see you!

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: You're always full of energy and you work so hard! And you look so cool with three famous idols next to you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You really think so...?

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: I do! I also saw your last stream with Nanamin! You really did your best, and I cheered for you the whole time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?! Thank you...!
But it went so bad and...

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: No, don't say that! I think it's amazing how you can take on really tough challenges like that. I wish I could be just like you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Like me?

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: The truth is, I'm on a team for a club at school, but my teammates are all really good. I always feel like I'm dragging them down...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: We've lost matches because of me and practices sometimes don't go as smoothly as we need them to, so I've been thinking about quitting...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, no...

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line:
But then I found MORE MORE JUMP!
Your streams always seem to cheer me up!

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: I feel like I can try again tomorrow and work on not making any mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: But I can't do what you do, Minori. Even when I come close to succeeding or figuring out something, I can't follow through...

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: Everyone else tells me to not worry about it, but I know I won't get any better by being pitied like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: And we can't lose our next match either.

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: I haven't been doing well during practice, so I feel like I'm going to disappoint everyone again...

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: I like my club, but maybe I should quit for everyone else's sake...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, you can't quit!

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If you really like something, you can't just give it up! If you keep trying, I'm sure things will go well...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The same thing just happened to me too... There's plenty that I still can't do and feel really bad about all the mistakes I've been making!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But even then, after all that, everyone tells me that there is no MORE MORE JUMP! without me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I'm sure... I'm positive that your teammates also believe in you too!

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line:
Minori, thank you...
But I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, right. That won't necessarily cheer them up. Even I kept feeling awful even after I was told something similar...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I want her to smile... I finally met someone that believes in me, so I have to give them hope...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... I-If it's alright with you, can I ask you to see our next stream?

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know our last one didn't go well as it could have...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I promise that the next one will succeed!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to show that even someone like me has what it takes. I want you to believe in yourself too...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'll definitely watch!
Break a leg!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you too...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I thought I wasn't doing anything or reaching anyone as an idol until now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I might be able to actually give someone hope...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This could be what Miku was talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I need to keep trying...!
More! More! More!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...!
